# ffxf_database_user (Resource)

Manages the user feature of an FFXF Cloud database. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_user" "example" {
  database_id = 42
  username    = "app"
  read_only   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Parent database ID.
- `username` (String) Username to create or manage.

### Optional

- `databases` (List of String) Logical databases this user can access; null grants the API default.
- `password_rotation_trigger` (String) Change this value to request a password reset.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the user is restricted to read-only access.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this managed database object.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password returned by create or password reset. The API does not return it on subsequent reads.
